Subject: Invoice delivery & VAT fields — how can we receive invoices?

Hi Markus,

We're putting Redwood onto our AP system and need to confirm how you'll deliver invoices. Our preference is to receive invoices via our supplier portal (URL provided separately), but we can accept emailed PDFs if that works better for vendors who can't onboard quickly.

A couple of specifics we need from you:
- Can you include a machine-readable XML (or EDI) payload in addition to the PDF? Our system parses XML attachments.
- For EU customers we require explicit VAT tagging (reverse charge where applicable). We need to see the VAT field and the country of supply on the invoice.
- Sample invoice (or schema) so we can validate mapping to our PO numbers — PO #8892 attached.

Do you have a short onboarding checklist and a staging address we can use for one test invoice? We'd like to get this live before the end of the month.

Thanks,
Elena Morales

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear note and the PO. Short answer: we can do both portal-first with email copies as a fallback, and we can attach a structured XML payload that follows our e-invoice schema.

High-level options we support:
- Portal push (preferred): we publish invoices to your portal via our portal integration and send an email copy to accounts-payable@therahealth.com.
- Email with XML: send PDF + XML attachment (schema attached) to a secure AP mailbox.
- SFTP / AS2 (for high-volume partners) as an alternative if you can open a secure endpoint.

On VAT tagging and schema: our XML contains a <TaxType> and <TaxReason> fields (we use a reverse_charge tag where appropriate) and an explicit <CountryOfSupply> element. I've attached the latest redwood-einvoice-spec-v2.xml for your mapping team.

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick 20-minute onboarding call to confirm mapping (PO->Invoice number, VAT flags). Can you do Tue 8/17 10:00am PT or Wed 8/18 9:00am PT?
2) We'll send a single staging invoice to a test mailbox you provide and confirm mapping.
3) Once validated we'll toggle portal publication and schedule the first production invoice.

I'll loop in Kimberly (billing ops) and Connor (AP integrations) to coordinate the onboarding timeline and firewall/SFTP questions.

Thanks — Mark

--
Markus Klein
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
